therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Parkinson's disease patients switching from immediate-release to continuous-release dopamine agonists
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: UPDRS Parts 3 and 4, MMSE, Clock Drawing Test, PHQ-9, ankle edema, patient satisfaction, PDQ-39

results.effect_size: UPDRS Part 3: 19.2 → 17.6; UPDRS Part 4: 5.1 → 2.9; PDQ-39: 32.3 → 31.1; Patient Satisfaction: 0.7 → 5.2; Ankle Edema: 225.11 → 224.38 mm
biomarker_changes: UPDRS Part 3 improved from 19.2 at baseline to 17.6 at 24 weeks
UPDRS Part 4 improved from 5.1 at baseline to 2.9 at 24 weeks
MMSE stable: 28.9 at baseline to 29.1 at 24 weeks
Clock Drawing Test slightly decreased: 9.8 at baseline to 9.4 at 24 weeks
PHQ-9 improved from 7.5 at baseline to 6.2 at 24 weeks
Ankle edema essentially unchanged: 225.11 mm at baseline to 224.38 mm at 24 weeks
Patient Satisfaction increased from 0.7 at baseline to 5.2 at 24 weeks
PDQ-39 slightly improved from 32.3 at baseline to 31.1 at 24 weeks
Epworth Sleepiness Scale improved from 18.2 at baseline to 11.9 at 24 weeks
